# Shivansh Elegance

> Shivansh Elegance is an Indian women's ethnic wear brand. It sells sarees,
> anarkalis, lehengas, kurtis and salwar suits, priced ₹1,599–₹5,899, with orders
> taken over WhatsApp and delivery across India.

## Key facts

- Brand: Shivansh Elegance
- Category: Women's Indian ethnic wear (sarees, anarkalis, lehengas, kurtis, salwar suits)
- Price range: ₹1,599 – ₹5,899
- How to order: on WhatsApp. The website has no checkout — every product and category
  button opens WhatsApp with a prefilled message.
- Delivery: pan-India, dispatched in 24–48 hours, typically 3–7 business days
- Payments: UPI, debit and credit cards, net banking (payment link sent on WhatsApp)
- Sizes: XS to XXL, made-to-measure on request
- Exchanges: 7-day exchange on unworn items with tags intact
- Support hours: Monday to Saturday, 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM IST
- Men's and children's collections are listed as "Coming Soon"

## Pages

- Home: https://shivanshelegance.github.io/shivanshelegance/ — brand overview, categories, featured pieces
- Women's collection: https://shivanshelegance.github.io/shivanshelegance/women/ — full catalog by category
- Men (coming soon): https://shivanshelegance.github.io/shivanshelegance/men/
- Child (coming soon): https://shivanshelegance.github.io/shivanshelegance/kids/
- Our story: https://shivanshelegance.github.io/shivanshelegance/about/
- FAQ: https://shivanshelegance.github.io/shivanshelegance/faq/ — ordering, delivery, sizing, payments, exchanges
- Contact: https://shivanshelegance.github.io/shivanshelegance/contact/ — WhatsApp ordering and support

## Collections

- Sarees: six yards of grace — silks, chiffons and handloom
- Anarkalis: flowing silhouettes for festive evenings
- Suits & Salwar Sets: everyday elegance, tailored to comfort
- Lehengas: occasion wear with real craftsmanship
- Kurtis: easy, breathable, endlessly wearable
